news.title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
news.summary: Strategy, Coinbase, Circle and Robinhood are among six companies from the venture’s initial selection with no disclosed objection, after 90% of issuers opted out.

news.title: U.S. prediction markets regulator issues demand that clashes directly with courts
news.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said regulated exchanges can't cut off customers state-by-state, but firms like Kalshi are under court orders to do so.

news.title: The crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story
news.summary: Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle are expanding into stablecoins, payments and prediction markets, but their latest earnings show how hard it is to escape crypto's boom-and-bust cycles.

news.title: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty
news.summary: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, alleging it ran an unlicensed crypto exchange for Thai users from 2022 to 2025.

news.title: U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October, blowing past 65,000 estimate
news.summary: The unemployment rate unexpectedly fell to 4.1%. The strong showing surely puts a December rate hike in play, but next week's inflation numbers and the fate of the stock market could prove more important.

news.title: Over $1 billion in bullish bets liquidated while ETF flows suggest no help in spot market
Live updates: Bitcoin flatlines under $76,000 as stock bounce loses steam into the close
news.summary: The Nasdaq gained just 1.1%, while the S&P 500 only edged higher, and the DJIA lost more ground.

news.title: Bitcoin steadies after AI-led selloff as eyes turn to latest U.S. jobs figures
news.summary: Bitcoin bounced from around $75,200 after Thursday’s AI-led selloff, which drove more than $1 billion in liquidations, as traders await the U.S. jobs report.

news.title: The AI trade is now counting on Anthropic’s IPO — but it couldn’t be happening at a worse time
news.summary: The ongoing tech selloff is leading investors to wonder if Anthropic will delay its IPO or list at a discount.

news.title: ‘I have no financial safety net’: I’m 66, rely on Social Security and have just $500 in savings. What hope do I have?
news.summary: “Sometimes I wonder whether wealthier Americans should trade places with people like me.”

news.title: Elon Musk opens the door for a big SpaceX acquisition
news.summary: The rocket and satellite-internet company is looking to challenge telecom giants.

news.title: Data centers run on debt. That was a problem for bonds this year — and it’s only going to get worse.
news.summary: AI debt issuance this year overwhelmed investor portfolios, and has disappointed from a performance perspective. The funding need won’t get any better with Democrats in control of Congress.

news.title: Nvidia, AMD and other chip stocks rebound — but is relief from the ‘violent’ selloff only temporary?
news.summary: Analysts warn of further volatility ahead, although there are several new factors that work in the AI trade’s favor.

news.title: ‘It seems bizarre’: We’re in our 80s with $950,000 in traditional IRAs. Why is our adviser pushing Roth conversions?
news.summary: “Our basic living expenses are covered by $110,000 in annual pensions and Social Security.”

news.title: ‘It feels like he’s quietly building a separate life’: My husband inherited $500,000, but he refuses to spend it on our home
news.summary: “Our kitchen dates from 1999 and the oven only works if you hit the door a certain way.”
